title: Execution Input
text:
Breadcrumbs
The
Execution Input
block is used to provide
input into a Sub-flow
. It defines the execution input that will be available wherever the sub-flow is used in your test.
The Execution Input block shows the following properties:
Note:
The screenshot on this page uses the
Elegance Design
, introduced in
2025.3
. If you are using an earlier version, your layout may look different.
Quick-start
Drag
Execution Input
onto the canvas.
Connect the block’s header output connector to the first block in the sub-flow that should receive the execution input.
Run the flow when it’s ready.
Building block parameters
Parameters
Block header
: The green output connector in the header is used to define the input execution. Connect it to the first block of the sub-flow that can receive input. When the sub-flow is used elsewhere in a test, the execution input defined here is available through this block. You can rename the block by double-clicking the header text and typing a new title.
